description:
A free offline Windows widget for learning Japanese kanji in the background.

KanjiWidget keeps kanji and example sentences visible on the Windows desktop, with furigana, English and Russian interfaces, FSRS spaced repetition, Anki .apkg import, custom decks, and active recall. It works offline without ads, accounts, or subscriptions.
Fixed the brief flicker when revealing or concealing details in Active recall mode. The main kanji, Japanese example, and example furigana now remain visually stationary while hidden details fade in or out.
